S: Buttermilk-soaked onion rings in a smoky paprika crumb, fried crisp
Thick onion rings dipped in buttermilk and seasoned flour, fried at 180C until crunchy, with a smoky ketchup.
Becky teaching Dante to dance on the roof

Buttery croissants filled with poached chicken, celery, grapes and toasted almonds in a lemon and tarragon mayo, with crisp cos leaves. Poach 2 chicken breasts in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred. Mix with 2 finely diced celery sticks, 100g halved red grapes, 40g toasted flaked almonds, 120g mayo, the juice of half a lemon and 1 tbsp chopped tarragon. Season well. Split 4 large croissants, line with cos leaves and pile in the chicken salad. Wrap in baking paper and pack in a basket.
Jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon
Halved jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
M: Two smashed beef patties with American cheese and special sauce
Two thin smashed patties, double American cheese, pickles, onion and burger sauce on a toasted sesame bun.
Mooby's hot honey crispy chicken burger
the other thing on the Mooby's menu

Buttermilk-soaked chicken thighs fried until crackling, brushed with hot honey, in soft buns with shredded lettuce, pickles and a garlic mayo. Soak 4 chicken thigh fillets in 250ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for at least 2 hours. Mix 150g plain flour, 1 tsp paprika, half a tsp cayenne and salt. Dredge and fry in oil at 170C for 7 to 8 minutes until golden and cooked through. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and a dash of vinegar and brush over the chicken. Toast 4 burger buns, spread with garlic mayo and fill with lettuce, chicken and pickles.
W: Vanilla sheet cake with buttercream and a goodbye message
Vanilla sheet cake baked in a tray, covered in buttercream and piped with a goodbye message across the top.
K: Chocolate ice cream, milk and chocolate syrup blended thick
Chocolate ice cream blended with cold milk and chocolate syrup until thick, poured into tall paper cups.

s.note: Buttermilk-soaked onion rings in a smoky paprika crumb, fried crisp
s.how: Slice 3 large onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 20 minutes. Dredge in 200g flour mixed with 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt, and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crunchy. Serve with 125ml tomato sauce stirred with a pinch more smoked paprika.

s.note: Jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon
s.how: Halve 12 jalapeños lengthways and scrape out the seeds. Mix 150g cream cheese with 80g grated cheddar and fill each half. Wrap each in half a rasher of bacon (6 rashers in total) and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

m.note: Two smashed beef patties with American cheese and special sauce
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash each flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and add a slice of American cheese. Stack 2 per toasted sesame bun with pickles, diced onion and 4 tbsp mayonnaise mixed with 1 tbsp tomato sauce.

w.note: Vanilla sheet cake with buttercream and a goodbye message
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 300g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake in a lined 20x30cm tin at 175C for 35 minutes and cool. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar for buttercream, spread over and pipe a goodbye message across the top.

d.note: Chocolate ice cream, milk and chocolate syrup blended thick
d.how: Blend 1L chocolate ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 4 tbsp chocolate syrup until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall paper cups and serve with straws.
